review.visual: Reviewed the exact final SHA, all 44 samples across 11 seconds at 4 fps, plus the title-card and spoken-subtitle transitions at 8 fps. Bobo remains recognizable as the original 3D brown monkey in the red shirt; the same rainbow pinwheel is visible throughout. Opening puff begins at 0.125s and the blades visibly rotate; from 1.5–8.0s Bobo tracks the rotating pinwheel with subtle head/eye and grip movement; from 8.25–10.75s he presents it, points and reacts. One brief opening compression/pixelation artifact is confined to approximately the first 0.125–0.25s and clears; no sustained corruption or broken scene. Movement is restrained during the tracking section but not frozen; brief pauses and minor mouth-sync imperfections are within the user's 17 October tolerance. No visual reuse is indicated by the unique generated SHA, new pinwheel story/scene, and ledger comparison.
